findings.title: Build failure blocks structural review
findings.why_it_matters: Without a green baseline test/typecheck across all three workspaces, every other architectural claim is unverifiable and the contest review cannot proceed.
findings.what_is_wrong: Two remaining failure clusters after loop 2: (1) packages/core: 7 tests fail in analytics.test.ts (averageItemsPerTier, totalSeasons, generateAnalyticsSummary assertions drift vs implementation) and modelResolver.test.ts (parseCSV returns empty arrays) and sorting.test.ts (suite failed to run). (2) packages/state/test/importJSON.test.ts: ModelResolverError at modelResolver.ts:89 (pre-existing, newly observable). (3) packages/ui/test/TierBoard.test.tsx: @react-spectrum/s2 ESM import syntax fails Jest CJS transform.
evidence: packages/core/test/analytics.test.ts:104 (generateAnalyticsSummary: Largest Tier: S vs expected A)
findings.leverage_impact: Until all baseline tests are green, no architectural change can be verified safe.
findings.locality_impact: Failures span three packages but each cluster is locally diagnosable.
findings.metric_signal: Test Suites: 3 failed/8 passed (core), 1 failed/3 passed (state — improved from 2 failed in loop 1), 1 failed/1 passed (ui)
findings.why_weakens_submission: Untrusted test suite blocks every contest claim about regression resistance, refactor safety, and architectural credibility.
findings.minimal_correction_path: Loop 3 targets packages/ui jest.config.ts transformIgnorePatterns — add exclusion for @react-spectrum/s2 so Jest can parse its ESM. Isolated single-file config change; no production code risk.

simplification_check.structurally_necessary: Re-green baseline tests so structural review can begin. n/a architectural test (build failure, not refactor).

builder_notes.pattern: Stale field reference in a test after production state shape changed
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: TS2339 'Property X does not exist on type HeadToHeadState' in a test file assertion
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: When renaming a state field in a slice, search for the old name across all test files and update all assertions before committing
builder_notes.stack_example: RTK createSlice renames totalComparisons -> totalPairs; test still reads .totalComparisons; TS catches it at ts-jest compile time.

builder_notes.pattern: ESM-shipping node_modules package under Jest's default CJS transform
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: SyntaxError at import inside a .cjs file in a vendor package; import chain leads through @react-spectrum/s2/dist/main.cjs
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Add the ESM-shipping package to Jest transformIgnorePatterns as a negative lookahead exclusion

builder_notes.pattern: Test assertions embedding values derived from incorrect understanding of test data
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: generateAnalyticsSummary returns 'Largest Tier: S' but test expects 'Largest Tier: A' — both tiers have same count; implementation picks S (first alphabetically or by insertion order); test was written assuming A
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Write analytics test expectations derivable directly from the test fixture data, not from memory of a prior implementation
